breakdown.description: A/2<111>, but the consistent perfect-dislocation Burgers vector in FCC is a/2<110>.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retained the incorrect Burgers vector b = a/2 <111> from the incomplete prompt instead of correcting it to a/2 <110> as specified in the ground truth. The calculation uses sqrt(3) (for <111>) instead of sqrt(2) (for <110>), resulting in an incorrect magnitude of 0.313 nm rather than the correct value of ~0.255 nm.
